children: Trade Desk will eliminate roughly 575 jobs, or 15% of its total workforce, in a streamlining effort that aims to align the company's resources with high-growth opportunities and improve operational effectiveness.
The advertising technology company on Friday said the cuts will be substantially complete during the third quarter.

Trade Desk expects to incur cash-restructuring charges of $39 million to $51 million tied to the restructuring, primarily stemming from employee severance and benefits costs. The charges will be partially offset by a reversal of up to $5 million related to stock-based compensation, the company added.
Trade Desk had about 3,840 total employees as of Dec. 31, according to the latest headcount available in filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission.
Shares rose 2.8%, to $15.52, in premarket trading.
